map.沙门氏菌、大肠埃希氏菌 O157 为致病菌零容忍，GB 29921 规定 n=0: Salmonella and E. coli O157 are zero-tolerance pathogens. GB 29921 sets n = 0 (not detectable in 25 g); any detection means the batch fails.
